status: Numbers written by Claude from otherday/label/sheets/*.jpg and taken as confirmed under the user's standing instruction of 2026-11-17 ("일단 다 초안대로"); not reviewed item by item.
method: Each upscaled rider crop was read by eye. Where a cap was ambiguous, the same silks in the other frame of the same race and the broadcaster's strip shown on the sheet were used. Boxes with no readable cap, two riders, or a second box on the same rider are null.
note: These frames were already scored by the identifier before labelling (otherday/RESULT_KO.md); the labels were written from the pictures, not from the identifier output.
